mapper.select: select * from t_history where user_num = #{userNum} and trade_date >= trunc(sysdate) and trade_date < trunc(sysdate) + 1 order by trade_date desc
select * from t_history where user_num = #{userNum} and trade_date >= trunc(sysdate) - 6 and trade_date < trunc(sysdate) + 1 order by trade_date desc
select * from t_history where user_num = #{userNum} and trade_date >= add_months(trunc(sysdate), -1) and trade_date < trunc(sysdate) + 1 order by trade_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into t_history(user_num, stock_code, trade_price, trade_cnt) values ( #{userNum}, #{stockCode}, #{tradePrice}, #{tradeCnt} )
